note: Private RV park just off I-80 exit 342 at Henderson, in open farm country: gravel pull-throughs in two blocks east of Road B, some shade trees, office/store and storm shelter. A small fishing lake with free paddleboats lies south, behind trees. Tap water runs high in nitrates; reverse-osmosis filling stations provided. No generators. Furnished cabin. --Claude
summary: The park's own site confirms 31 gravel pull-throughs (30 A at 60 ft, 50 A full hookups at 90 ft), $50 a night for 2026 plus taxes and fees, free Wi-Fi, showers, a dump and a small store; booking via ResNexus. All written. The gate holds at exactly $50 (not over), with a vague 'taxes and fees' line. It brands itself 'Prairie Oasis RV Park'. Not waterfront confirmed.
